human_tolerance.notes: Judgement: grassland, savanna and woodland specialist (Wikipedia). No source checked reports suburban or garden use.

phases.name: breeding
phases.note: Placeholder year-round phase. Wikipedia (citing Estes 1991): seasonal breeders, rut at the end of the rains or start of the dry season, births near the start of the next rains. Timing varies by region and no region-scoped dated calendar was sourced, so this phase is not a calendar claim.

external.note: GBIF 2441212 is the accepted species key. iNaturalist 42122 (P3151), NCBI 41426 (P685) via Wikidata; iNaturalist API checked 2026-10-31 (active, species rank).

range.note: Union of the four subspecies' distributions in the Wikipedia Subspecies table (Nolan/northern, Eritrean, Eastern/Central, Southern). Native only; no introduced range appeared in the checked text. Not checked against a range map.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Wikipedia: flees by sprinting, up to 48 km/h with tail raised. No trot evidence was checked, so Trot is not declared.

traits.thermoregulation.note: Warm-blooded mammal; mud wallowing for temperature regulation per Wikipedia.

traits.skin.note: Sparse coat with bristles; mapped to the Fur enum.

traits.size_class.note: From mass_kg 82.5 (Large is 50 kg or more).

traits.mass_kg.note: Unweighted mean of two range midpoints. Females 45-75 kg (midpoint 60); males 60-150 kg (midpoint 105); (60+105)/2 = 82.5. Assumes equal sex weighting, which the source does not give.

traits.mass_range_kg.note: Union of female 45-75 kg and male 60-150 kg.

traits.length_m.note: Midpoint of head-and-body length 0.9-1.5 m (Wikipedia). The schema field is nose to tail tip; the tail was not sourced, so this understates total length.

traits.lifespan_y.note: Midpoint of Wikipedia's 'average of 7 to 11 years in the wild' (the Selous Game Reserve figure, Boshe 1984 as cited by ADW). Not the 18-year maximum or the captive average (about 21 years). ADW gives the same typical wild range, but it is not used here to avoid widening NC coverage.

traits.diet.note: Authored shares. Wikipedia lists grasses, roots, bulbs and rhizomes, berries and fruits, bark, fungi, dung, insects, eggs and carrion, but no proportions. Roots and bulbs are folded into graze.

traits.social.note: Structure Group from Wikipedia (sounders). Upper size 18 from ADW (NC). Lower bound 2 is derived.

traits.activity_pattern.note: ADW: primarily diurnal, takes refuge at night in burrows. NC last resort: no permissive source checked states the diel pattern. Wikipedia is silent on it.

traits.defense.note: Primary defence is flight by sprinting.

habitat.use.note: Authored. Sparse; ground use dominates, with burrow use for refuge. No time-budget source.

habitat.resources.note: graze, fruit, invertebrate and carrion from Wikipedia. Burrow shelter from Wikipedia (reverses into burrows; occupies aardvark burrows). Weights are authored.

seasonal.note: Placeholder year-round phase, see the phase note. Not a regional calendar.

behavior.note: Shared fsm-ground-forager-v1 with food_tag graze (grazing), forage_gait walk, flee_gait gallop (sprint), and rest_sun_lo_deg -90 / rest_sun_hi_deg -6 so that rest falls at night for a diurnal animal. Known limit: the program has no rooting or wallowing action, and burrow rest is modelled as a generic shelter rest.

look.note: judgement: colours and proportions are authored for the previewer, with no image-based measurement.

habitat.shelter_tag.note: Wikipedia: reverses into burrows; often occupies abandoned aardvark burrows.
